cloudBanks.method: connected 3D cloud banks traced along final-mesh contours; regular depth occlusion; deterministic bounded drift

grass.method: candidate: both blade base endpoints projected into actual clipped support face; zero height offset

localTail.method: local castle-coordinate lower-slope window; area-weighted actual turf geometric slope, continuous field clipping on source triangles

groundcover.method: low-frequency continuous coordinate colour; barycentric source shading normals; two shared-edge refinement levels then final-face continuous clipping; whole-face steep/protection gates retained; actual first-surface center test and grass endpoint tests

tailShrubSupport.method: local candidate5 only; actual radial root against final turf before all instance parts are built

canopy.method: opaque lobed 3D crowns; low-frequency woodland field; exact final-surface roots

newCityRidge.oldJoin: submerged overlap; not topologically welded; actual visual seam acceptance pending

summits.method: local eccentric eastern crest and descending spur; bounded target delta, protected deformation

summitCut.method: actual-silhouette-guided post-pass3 eastward descending crest subtraction
summitCut.evidence: r11-old-mountain-day-noCloud-plants.json silhouetteProfile; CPU geometric skyline, original ray error0
